## Checks

- S06 class imbalance: most frequent class 'tôi' is 23.1% of rows (majority baseline); top-1 without it 63.3%; class-balanced top-1 64.4% over 365 classes.
- Mode collapse: QIPEDC predictions use 315 distinct labels (top-10 labels = 10% of predictions); S06 304 labels.
- Source confound: 99.9% of S06 predictions are VSL-GH-vocabulary words vs 11.4% of QIPEDC predictions; QIPEDC rows whose word also has VSL-GH training data: 31 rows, top-1 0.0%.
- Sentence overlap: 100.0% of S06 segments come from sentences also signed by training signers (300 S06 sentences) → S06 measures an unseen signer, not unseen sentences.
